question: A rectangular plot has a length of 12.75 m and a width of 6.2 m. What is its area?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert the decimal values into fractions for faster multiplication:

Length = 12.75 = 51/4 m

Width = 6.2 = 31/5 m

Area = (51/4) × (31/5) = 1581/20

⇒ Area = 158.1 ÷ 2 = 79.05 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 79.05 m².**
